title: The Twin Lives School Course
summary: A school course in living as two selves at once: a second hand of qi that strikes and heals and a closing rite that binds two pulses.

title: The Hawk and Basin Reborn Canon
summary: A school canon of ash and ember in which the core burns down and rises again and carries the fallen up with it.

title: The Oath of the Returning Spirit Course
summary: A school course on the oath that a spirit sworn to the wind shall come back: taps and chains and a calling rite.

title: Manual of the Sworn Endless Wheel
summary: A school manual of a wheel that never stops: the core turns every blow into breath and sweeps all that stands before it.
